description: Read your personal subscription balance and get the link the human opens to subscribe or manage their allowance when credits are short. Charges nothing and never starts a paid checkout. `topUpAvailable` says whether the human can buy a pack of never-expiring credits from the dashboard (`dashboardUrl`) now, which also switches on automatic top-ups or resumes paused ones; the message mentions top-ups only when it is true. An existing subscriber gets the dashboard and reset date. After the human finishes checkout, use get_budget to verify the credits, then retry pay_service. OAuth commerce connections must explicitly grant Nevermined credits.
name: get_subscription_checkout
title: Subscription checkout and credits
